metadata.source: Research compilation — Wikidata Q-IDs verified via wikidata.org API and SPARQL
metadata.description: World War I, Spanish/Latin American, and additional global figures with their media depictions. Fills WWI gap and adds Mesoamerican/South American coverage.

figures.name: Archduke Franz Ferdinand
figures.title: Heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne
figures.description: Heir presumptive whose assassination in Sarajevo by Gavrilo Princip on June 28, 1914 triggered the chain of events that led to World War I

figures.name: Gavrilo Princip
figures.title: Bosnian assassin
figures.description: Bosnian Serb nationalist who assassinated Archduke Franz Ferdinand, firing the shot that triggered World War I

figures.name: T. E. Lawrence
figures.title: British army officer and author
figures.description: Lawrence of Arabia — British officer who led the Arab Revolt against the Ottoman Empire, becoming one of the most legendary figures of the 20th century

figures.name: Manfred von Richthofen
figures.title: German fighter pilot
figures.description: The Red Baron, the most successful fighter ace of World War I with 80 confirmed victories, shot down and killed over the Somme in 1918

figures.name: Mata Hari
figures.title: Exotic dancer and accused spy
figures.description: Dutch exotic dancer who became a Paris sensation, convicted of spying for Germany and executed by firing squad — her guilt remains debated

figures.name: Woodrow Wilson
figures.title: 28th President of the United States
figures.description: President who led America into World War I to 'make the world safe for democracy' and championed the League of Nations, winning the Nobel Peace Prize

figures.name: Kaiser Wilhelm II
figures.title: German Emperor and King of Prussia
figures.description: Last German Emperor whose aggressive foreign policy and naval expansion contributed to World War I, abdicated in 1918 and lived in Dutch exile until his death

figures.name: Mustafa Kemal Ataturk
figures.title: Founder of the Republic of Turkey
figures.description: Military commander at Gallipoli who became the founding father of modern Turkey, transforming the Ottoman remnant into a secular republic through sweeping reforms

figures.name: Edith Cavell
figures.title: British nurse
figures.description: British nurse who helped 200 Allied soldiers escape from German-occupied Belgium, executed by firing squad and becoming a powerful propaganda symbol

figures.name: Hernan Cortes
figures.title: Spanish conquistador
figures.description: Led the expedition that caused the fall of the Aztec Empire, conquering Tenochtitlan with a small force of Spaniards and Indigenous allies

figures.name: Francisco Pizarro
figures.title: Spanish conquistador
figures.description: Conquered the Inca Empire with a tiny force, capturing Emperor Atahualpa at Cajamarca in one of history's most audacious military gambits

figures.name: Simon Bolivar
figures.title: Liberator of South America
figures.description: Venezuelan military leader who led the independence movements of Venezuela, Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Panama, known as El Libertador

figures.name: Frida Kahlo
figures.title: Mexican painter
figures.description: Revolutionary Mexican artist known for her surrealist self-portraits exploring identity, the body, and death, becoming an icon of feminism and Mexican culture

figures.name: Pancho Villa
figures.title: Mexican revolutionary general
figures.description: Charismatic guerrilla leader of the Mexican Revolution who raided Columbus, New Mexico, prompting the only US military invasion of Mexico in the 20th century

figures.name: Che Guevara
figures.title: Argentine revolutionary
figures.description: Argentine Marxist revolutionary and guerrilla leader who played a key role in the Cuban Revolution, executed in Bolivia and became a global icon of rebellion

figures.name: Moctezuma II
figures.title: Aztec Emperor
figures.description: Ninth tlatoani of Tenochtitlan who ruled the Aztec Empire at its zenith, his encounter with Cortes led to the fall of the most powerful Mesoamerican civilization

figures.name: Atahualpa
figures.title: Last Inca Emperor
figures.description: The last sovereign ruler of the Inca Empire, captured by Pizarro at Cajamarca despite commanding an army of 80,000, executed after paying history's largest ransom

works.title: Lawrence of Arabia
works.creator: David Lean
works.description: Epic biographical film following T. E. Lawrence's role in the Arab Revolt during World War I, widely considered one of the greatest films ever made

works.creator: Sam Mendes
works.description: War film shot to appear as a single continuous take, following two British soldiers on a desperate mission across No Man's Land to save 1,600 men from a trap

works.title: All Quiet on the Western Front (novel)
works.creator: Erich Maria Remarque
works.description: Devastating anti-war novel about a young German soldier's experience in the trenches of World War I, one of the most influential war novels ever written

works.title: Gallipoli
works.creator: Peter Weir
works.description: Australian film following two young sprinters who enlist in the Australian army and fight in the disastrous Gallipoli Campaign of 1915

works.title: War Horse
works.creator: Steven Spielberg
works.description: A young man searches for his beloved horse who has been sold to the cavalry and shipped to France during World War I

works.title: Apocalypto
works.creator: Mel Gibson
works.description: Action epic set in the declining Maya civilization, following a young man captured for human sacrifice who must escape to save his family

works.title: The Motorcycle Diaries
works.creator: Walter Salles
works.description: Road film based on Che Guevara's journals of his 1952 motorcycle journey across South America, the trip that radicalized the future revolutionary

works.title: Frida
works.creator: Julie Taymor
works.description: Biographical film starring Salma Hayek as Frida Kahlo, depicting her tumultuous life, art, politics, and passionate marriage to Diego Rivera

works.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
works.creator: Werner Herzog
works.description: A Spanish expedition descends into madness as the megalomaniac Aguirre leads a doomed search for El Dorado down the Amazon, a masterpiece of New German Cinema

works.title: Braveheart
works.creator: Mel Gibson
works.description: Epic depicting William Wallace's fight for Scottish independence against English rule, winner of five Academy Awards despite historical liberties

works.title: Gladiator
works.creator: Ridley Scott
works.description: A betrayed Roman general fights his way back from slavery to confront the corrupt emperor who murdered his family, reviving the historical epic genre

works.title: Ben-Hur
works.creator: William Wyler
works.description: Monumental epic about a Jewish prince betrayed by his Roman friend, featuring the legendary chariot race — winner of eleven Academy Awards

works.title: Troy
works.creator: Wolfgang Petersen
works.description: Retelling of the Trojan War focusing on the rivalry between Achilles and Hector, stripping the myth of its gods to tell a human drama of love and war

works.title: Kingdom of Heaven
works.creator: Ridley Scott
works.description: Epic depicting a blacksmith who becomes defender of Jerusalem during the Crusades, culminating in the siege by Saladin's forces

works.title: Downfall
works.creator: Oliver Hirschbiegel
works.description: Harrowing depiction of Hitler's final days in his Berlin bunker as the Soviet army closes in, based on the memoirs of his secretary Traudl Junge

works.title: The Pianist
works.creator: Roman Polanski
works.description: True story of pianist Wladyslaw Szpilman's survival of the Warsaw Ghetto, winner of the Palme d'Or and three Academy Awards

works.title: Cleopatra
works.creator: Joseph L. Mankiewicz
works.description: Lavish epic starring Elizabeth Taylor as the Egyptian queen, depicting her relationships with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony — the most expensive film ever made at the time

properties.notes: Spanish arrival depicted at end of Apocalypto
Franz Ferdinand's assassination is the backstory of 1917
